summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Cat Versus Ghost. Backend /api/scores POST & GET fully validated (9/9 pytest passed). Frontend: main menu, level select (lock/unlock via localStorage), Level 1 gameplay (card placement, moonlight cost, occupied tile no-op, cooldown data-ready, affordability data-affordable, snack, shovel, pause modal, speed button), lose flow, win flow (stars, next-level, unlocked persistence), boss level 6 (boss-health-bar, ghost-unit boss, POSSESSION banner), endless mode + leaderboard submission (rank returned, /leaderboard page shows rows), almanac tabs (cats/ghosts/collection/rules) with all sample entries, mobile portrait rotate-device-hint, mobile menu no horizontal overflow. All flows work end-to-end.

issues: Bottom footer text 'Rekor Endless' and 'Level terbuka: 1/6' has low contrast against the moonlit rooftop illustration - hard to read on mobile. Consider adding a subtle backdrop or increasing text contrast.

action_items: (Optional) Improve contrast of bottom stats row on mobile main menu (dark text over dark illustration).

Pydantic validation on ScoreCreate (empty/long/negative) properly returns 422.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_scores_api.py (pytest, 9 tests). For frontend, always set localStorage cvg_progress_v1 BEFORE navigating to /play/6?debug=1 (level select redirects if locked). Use `for(let i=0;i<8000 && window.__cvg.state().status==='playing';i++) window.__cvg.step(window.__cvg.state(),0.05)` to fast-forward.
